# NextUnicorn

> Daily AI-generated SaaS startup ideas, ranked by community votes.

## What is NextUnicorn?

NextUnicorn is a free platform that publishes fresh SaaS startup ideas every day. Each idea enters a head-to-head voting arena where entrepreneurs, developers, and indie hackers decide which concepts have the most potential. The best ideas rise to the top of the leaderboard.

## Key pages

- Homepage (voting arena): https://nextunicorn.app
- Startup Ideas catalog: https://nextunicorn.app/startup-ideas
- Trending Startup Ideas: https://nextunicorn.app/trending-startup-ideas
- AI SaaS Ideas: https://nextunicorn.app/ai-saas-ideas
- Micro SaaS Ideas: https://nextunicorn.app/micro-saas-ideas
- Micro SaaS Ideas for Developers: https://nextunicorn.app/micro-saas-ideas-for-developers
- Leaderboard (Hall of Fame): https://nextunicorn.app/leaderboard
- Blog: https://nextunicorn.app/blog
- About: https://nextunicorn.app/about
- Advertise: https://nextunicorn.app/advertise

## How it works

1. Every day, AI generates 10 new SaaS ideas based on market trends and community voting signals.
2. Ideas are paired in head-to-head duels. Users swipe or click to choose the stronger concept.
3. Winning ideas accumulate ranking points. The leaderboard shows the all-time best ideas.
4. Each idea has a dedicated page with problem statement, target users, business model, features, and community vote statistics.

## Target audience

Entrepreneurs, software developers, indie hackers, startup founders, and anyone looking for validated SaaS product ideas.

## Languages

Content is available in English (primary), French, German, and Spanish.
